outcome: ICSI parameters (hormonal, ultrasonic, stimulation drug doses and duration)
cohort: 40 infertile women who had successful ICSI cycles, divided into 2 groups: 20 with PCOS and 20 without PCOS, matched for age and body mass index.
finding: StAR gene expression was significantly higher in PCOS women and was correlated with estradiol levels and doses of recombinant follicle-stimulating hormone and human menopausal gonadotropin used during ICSI.
